cause_quote: The desktop rule `.chat-details .chat-details-desktop-body .chat-details-subagents__avatar { background: transparent; color: var(--muted); }` overrode each avatar's identity colors, and adding `.chat-details-subagents__avatar` to the shared sizing selector shrank the stacked avatars to 16px.
user_saw: The Subagents summary in both docked and floating desktop Details showed overlapping gray robot icons in place of individually tinted avatars.
summary: The fix restores subagent identity colors and limits desktop row-icon sizing to expanded rows so the summary avatars retain their native 20px size.
reasoning: The parent of #189537 already styled stacked subagent avatars as 20px chips with hue-based backgrounds and 14px glyphs, and its desktop stylesheet left those styles in effect. The #189537 diff added a higher-specificity color override and applied the shared row-icon sizing to the existing stack, directly causing the gray, crowded appearance.
